sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Dark mode
Follows the system dark theme across XML and Compose screens.
Disable analytics
Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions, plus AppsFlyer.
Disable analytics (Wear OS)
Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions, plus AppsFlyer on the Wear OS companion app.
GmsCore support

Makes "Sign in with Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, while keeping Wear OS watch sync on Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Hide category header emoji
Removes emoji and icons from category headers on the home screen.
Hide hero carousel
Removes the promotional banner carousel at the top of the home screen.
Hide Looks like tip
Removes the "See a Look you like?" onboarding banner from the Looks tab.
Hide storefront pill icons
Removes icons from the storefront filter pills at the top of the home screen.
Hide welcome card
Removes the Welcome to Facer and promotional message cards on the home screen.
Premium unlock
Unlocks Facer Premium, Facer Plus, and removes ads.
Premium unlock (Wear OS)
Unlocks Facer Premium and Facer Plus on the Wear OS companion app.
Stop Featured Looks autoplay
Pauses Featured Looks videos on the home screen at 1 second instead of autoplaying them.
Stop video autoplay
Stops Looks feed and promo videos from playing on their own while keeping Looks detail playback working.
